prototype_model.wind_score: Observed nearest-track wind divided by 120 km/h, capped at 1, then multiplied by a distance factor declining from 1.0 to 0.5 at 140 km.
prototype_model.terrain_flood_score: 70% elevation vulnerability (1 at <=5 m, declining linearly to 0 at >=30 m) plus 30% historical surface-water occurrence.
prototype_model.combined_risk_score: 65% wind score plus 35% terrain flood score.
prototype_model.warning: Prototype screening index only; not an operational, physics-based cyclone, flood, storm-surge, or infrastructure damage model.
